content:
Following this week's Apple event, newly appointed Apple CEO John Ternus and Senior Vice President of Marketing Greg Joswiak gave interviews, further discussing the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.

In interviews with Tom's Guide and TechRadar, Ternus and Joswiak discussed why Apple believes now is the right time to enter the foldable screen market. Ternus also shared his feelings during his first week as Apple CEO.

When asked why Apple thinks now is the right time to announce the iPhone Duo, Ternus explained:

"For us, the key has always been when we feel we have a product concept that meets our standards for quality, durability, and design. I think what makes the Duo particularly outstanding is that it's a perfect example of hardware and software integration, creating a truly distinctive product. For us, it's like a virgin land, full of opportunities to rethink various elements. You can feel this from the hardware, software to design. Everything comes together naturally, it just feels like the right product."

Joz added that Apple believes other smartphone manufacturers' performance in the foldable screen field has been "completely uninspiring."

"If you've been paying attention to similar products on the market, they're not only very plasticky and feel cheap, but the screens are also a bit uneven and creased." Ternus added, with criticism directed at competitors' foldable screen phones.
